issues.question: Which surveyed or explicitly fictional geometry will support motion prediction?
issues.required_evidence: Document coordinate frame, units, origin/CRS, accuracy, source and review. No coordinates may be added to v1 drafts.

issues.question: Where exactly are each approach-side hold line and protected boundary?
issues.required_evidence: Expert review, source-marked location, approach direction and independent coordinates; split segments at verified boundaries.

issues.question: Which closures, access restrictions and direction permissions apply at the exercise time?
issues.required_evidence: Applicable chart cycle, NOTAMs, airport restrictions, review timestamp; expiry-time semantics not inferred from printed dates.

issues.question: Does the October diagram match any historical incident used in the story?
issues.required_evidence: Incident-date chart and change comparison; current diagram alone is insufficient.

issues.question: Are the visible links and intervening junctions correct and sufficient for the chosen route?
issues.required_evidence: Expert-marked diagram; accepted node order and hold boundaries; retain alternatives until resolved.

issues.question: Which independent observations establish actor position, speed and uncertainty?
issues.required_evidence: Timestamped observed or explicitly simulated tracks, actor association, uncertainty, footprint, stale-input rules and time basis.

issues.question: What is the exact connectivity among P, R, S, G, Q, AA and B in HS 1/HS 2?
issues.required_evidence: Primary chart close-up plus expert review; earlier Addendum 14 calls this a best reading. Do not turn the list into an ordered route.

issues.question: The prior graph (source PRIOR-LGA-GRAPH; its file is not in this copy) was recovered and compared. It asserted ordered connector lists along A and B, an E crossing of 4/22, C/D/F/G/P/R crossings and Fire-Station→D access as 'best reading'. Which of those, if any, should be promoted?
issues.required_evidence: Expert-marked chart for each claimed crossing and ordering; do not import prior claims without that review. Draft2 imports none except the Delta crossing, which it independently re-checked.

issues.question: Complete the remaining identifier inventory and distinguish taxiway H from H1 helipad / lighting symbols.
issues.required_evidence: Visual expert pass on the full diagram; this selected inventory makes no completeness claim.

issues.question: East of runway 4/22, the label nearest the runway on the connector NE of Delta reads F, while an E label sits east of the B parallel. Does E itself cross 4/22, or does E end at B with F (or another connector) carrying the crossing?
issues.required_evidence: Expert reading of the chart (or the Chart Supplement / airport layout) naming each connector between AA, the runway, B and A; needed before any E or F crossing node, and before resolving the N–A–E route.

issues.question: No LAHSO hold markings or LAHSO notes were seen on this airport diagram. Are LAHSO operations published for LGA in the current cycle?
issues.required_evidence: Chart Supplement LAHSO table for the effective cycle. Absence on the diagram is not proof of absence.

issues.question: Which pavement connects the Fire Station area to Delta (or another taxiway)? Draft2 adds no area-to-graph connector.
issues.required_evidence: Expert-marked access route; vehicle service roads may not be charted.
